## Bugs found + fixed 2026-08-29 (post-initial-implementation)
7. **`firstRun` was `!existsSync(node_modules)` only — stale once a template gains a new linked
   `@pantoken/*` dep.** A `.dev/<platform>` dir created before e.g. `@pantoken/css`/`@pantoken/components`
   were added as deps never re-runs `vp install`/`vp link` for them on later `scaffold:dev` invocations
   (node_modules already exists from the earlier run) — the new dep silently never gets installed at
   all, not just left unlinked. Symptom: Vite "Failed to resolve import '@pantoken/css/...'" even
   though the package is right there in `formats/css/dist`. Fix: replaced the check with
   `needsFirstTimeSetup()` that also verifies every current `linkedDeps()` entry is actually a symlink
   at `node_modules/@pantoken/<name>` (an `ENOENT`/non-symlink means re-run `firstTimeSetup`).
8. **The isolated `.dev/<platform>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`packages: []`) has no `catalog:` section**,
   but real scaffold templates (canvas-theme-editor's codemirror/tinymce deps) use `"catalog:"` version
   specifiers meant to resolve against the monorepo root's catalog. Without copying it in, `vp install`
   fails with `ERR_PNPM_CATALOG_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND_FOR_SPEC`. Fix: `prepareDevDir` now appends a verbatim
   copy of the root `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s `catalog:` block (extracted by finding the `catalog:` line
   through the next top-level key) into the isolated one.
9. **Known unrelated follow-on bug, not fixed**: once css/components/tinymce all install correctly,
   Vite's dep-prebundle step fails on `@pantoken/plugin-simple-icons` (a transitive dep of the
   published `@pantoken/tinymce`) — `"./manifest.json" is not exported under the conditions [...]
   from package .../plugin-simple-icons/package.json`. That package isn't part of this repo (external
   published dep resolved from the registry) — its own `exports` map needs a `./manifest.json` entry
   under the `import`/`browser` conditions. Out of scope for scaffold-dev.ts; a separate published-
   package bug.
10. **`multi_replace_string_in_file`/`replace_string_in_file` can silently report success without the
   change persisting** if a later edit in the same batch invalidates earlier context — always re-grep
   for a newly-added symbol name after editing to confirm it actually landed, don't trust the "success"
   report alone for multi-part edits to the same file.

## vp link semantics (confirmed)

I fixed two real bugs in `packages/scaffold/scripts/scaffold-dev.ts` that caused the reported `@pantoken/css` import failure:

1. **Stale first-run detection**: `firstTimeSetup` (which runs `vp install` + `vp link`) only ran if `node_modules` didn't exist. Since the `.dev/canvas-theme-editor` dir was from an earlier run predating `@pantoken/css`/`@pantoken/components` being added as deps, those packages were never installed at all — not just unlinked. Replaced with a `needsFirstTimeSetup()` check that verifies every currently-declared linked dep is actually symlinked.
2. **Missing catalog entries**: the isolated dev workspace's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`packages: []`) had no `catalog:` section, but the template's `codemirror`/`tinymce` deps use `"catalog:"` specifiers that only resolve against the root catalog. Fixed by copying the root catalog block verbatim into the isolated workspace file.

Verified end-to-end: `@pantoken/css`, `@pantoken/components`, and friends now install and link correctly, and Vite resolves the previously-failing import. A separate, unrelated issue surfaced downstream in the published `@pantoken/plugin-simple-icons` package's `exports` map (missing `./manifest.json` entry) — that's an external package bug outside this repo, not something scaffold-dev.ts can fix.
